contents.description: The various content types in the sitemap.

submitted.description: The number of URLs in the sitemap (of the content type).

errors.description: Number of errors in the sitemap. These are issues with the sitemap itself that need to be fixed before it can be processed correctly.

isPending.description: If true, the sitemap has not been processed.

lastSubmitted.description: Date & time in which this sitemap was submitted. Date format is in RFC 3339 format (yyyy-mm-dd).

type.description: The type of the sitemap. For example: `rssFeed`.

warnings.description: Number of warnings for the sitemap. These are generally non-critical issues with URLs in the sitemaps.

parameters.description: Page URL to inspect. Leave empty to inspect the property home page.
parameters.name: inspection_url

inspectionResult.description: URL inspection result, including all inspection results.

ampResult.description: AMP inspection result of the live page or the current information from Google's index, depending on whether you requested a live inspection or not.

ampIndexStatusVerdict.description: Index status of the AMP URL.

ampUrl.description: URL of the AMP that was inspected. If the submitted URL is a desktop page that refers to an AMP version, the AMP version will be inspected.

indexingState.description: Whether or not the page blocks indexing through a noindex rule.

issues.description: A list of zero or more AMP issues found for the inspected URL.

lastCrawlTime.description: Last time this AMP version was crawled by Google. Absent if the URL was never crawled successfully.

pageFetchState.description: Whether or not Google could fetch the AMP.

robotsTxtState.description: Whether or not the page is blocked to Google by a robots.txt rule.

verdict.description: The status of the most severe error on the page. If a page has both warnings and errors, the page status is error. Error status means the page cannot be shown in Search results.

indexStatusResult.description: Results of index status inspection for either the live page or the version in Google's index, depending on whether you requested a live inspection or not. For more information, see the [Index coverage report documentation](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/7440203).

coverageState.description: Could Google find and index the page. More details about page indexing appear in 'indexing_state'.

crawledAs.description: Primary crawler that was used by Google to crawl your site.

googleCanonical.description: The URL of the page that Google selected as canonical. If the page was not indexed, this field is absent.

indexingState.description: Whether or not the page blocks indexing through a noindex rule.

lastCrawlTime.description: Last time this URL was crawled by Google using the [primary crawler](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/7440203#primary_crawler). Absent if the URL was never crawled successfully.

pageFetchState.description: Whether or not Google could retrieve the page from your server. Equivalent to ["page fetch"](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9012289#index_coverage) in the URL inspection report.

referringUrls.description: URLs that link to the inspected URL, directly and indirectly.

robotsTxtState.description: Whether or not the page is blocked to Google by a robots.txt rule.

sitemap.description: Any sitemaps that this URL was listed in, as known by Google. Not guaranteed to be an exhaustive list, especially if Google did not discover this URL through a sitemap. Absent if no sitemaps were found.

userCanonical.description: The URL that your page or site [declares as canonical](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/advanced/crawling/consolidate-duplicate-urls?#define-canonical). If you did not declare a canonical URL, this field is absent.

verdict.description: High level verdict about whether the URL *is* indexed (indexed status), or *can be* indexed (live inspection).

inspectionResultLink.description: Link to Search Console URL inspection.

issues.description: A list of zero or more mobile-usability issues detected for this URL.

verdict.description: High-level mobile-usability inspection result for this URL.

richResultsResult.description: Rich-Results inspection result, including any rich results found at this URL.

detectedItems.description: A list of zero or more rich results detected on this page. Rich results that cannot even be parsed due to syntactic issues will not be listed here.

verdict.description: High-level rich results inspection result for this URL.

data.description: A list of rows, one per result, grouped by key. Metrics in each row are aggregated for all data grouped by that key either by page or property, as specified by the aggregation type parameter.

metadata.description: An object that may be returned with your query results, providing context about the state of the data. When you request recent data (using `all` or `hourly_all` for `dataState`), some of the rows returned may represent data that is incomplete, which means that the data is still being collected and processed. This metadata object helps you identify exactly when this starts and ends. All dates and times provided in this object are in the `America/Los_Angeles` time zone. The specific field returned within this object depends on how you've grouped your data in the request. See details in inner fields.

firstIncompleteDate.description: The first date for which the data is still being collected and processed, presented in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (ISO-8601 extended local date format). This field is populated only when the request's `dataState` is "`all`", data is grouped by "`DATE`", and the requested date range contains incomplete data points. All values after the `first_incomplete_date` may still change noticeably.

firstIncompleteHour.description: The first hour for which the data is still being collected and processed, presented in `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss[+|-]hh:mm` format (ISO-8601 extended offset date-time format). This field is populated only when the request's `dataState` is "`hourly_all`", data is grouped by "`HOUR`" and the requested date range contains incomplete data points. All values after the `first_incomplete_hour` may still change noticeably.

rows.description: A list of rows grouped by the key values in the order given in the query.

next_cursor.description: Continuation token or offset to pass to the next request.

description: Read search performance, inspect indexed URLs, and manage Search Console properties and sitemaps.

google_search_console_new_property_trigg.description: Runs for each new property in Google Search Console. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields permissionLevel, siteUrl

google_search_console_new_sitemap_trigge.description: Runs for each new sitemap in Google Search Console. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields isSitemapsIndex, lastSubmitted, type, path, isPending, lastDownloaded, contents, warnings, errors

google_search_console_updated_sitemap_tr.description: Runs for each sitemap added or changed in Google Search Console. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields isSitemapsIndex, lastSubmitted, type, path, isPending, lastDownloaded, contents, warnings, errors
